schema:name: solid-apps registry
schema:description: A curated, community-submitted directory of Solid apps (rail-level UIs) and panes (per-subject renderers). Apps follow the hub-pod app interface (meta + render); panes follow SLIP-48. Hosts (hub, pilot, others) read this list to surface installable entries to users.

schema:itemListElement.schema:name: Pad
schema:itemListElement.schema:description: A markdown scratchpad. Auto-saves to localStorage.
schema:itemListElement.schema:author: hub-pod

schema:itemListElement.schema:name: Sticky
schema:itemListElement.schema:description: Coloured sticky notes you can drag around. Persists to localStorage.
schema:itemListElement.schema:author: hub-pod

schema:itemListElement.schema:name: Clock
schema:itemListElement.schema:description: Live clocks for multiple time zones.
schema:itemListElement.schema:author: hub-pod

schema:itemListElement.schema:name: Pomodoro
schema:itemListElement.schema:description: Work/break timer with audio cue. 25/5 default, configurable.
schema:itemListElement.schema:author: hub-pod

schema:itemListElement.schema:name: Markdown
schema:itemListElement.schema:description: Live markdown editor with split-view preview.
schema:itemListElement.schema:author: hub-pod

schema:itemListElement.schema:name: Drawing pad
schema:itemListElement.schema:description: Canvas sketch pad with color, brush size, and Save PNG.
schema:itemListElement.schema:author: hub-pod

schema:itemListElement.schema:name: Pilot Tracker
schema:itemListElement.schema:description: Renders wf:Tracker resources as a kanban-style task list.
schema:itemListElement.schema:author: solid-apps

schema:itemListElement.schema:name: Table Explorer
schema:itemListElement.schema:description: Table-style LDP container browser with Name / Type / Size / Modified columns.
schema:itemListElement.schema:author: hub-pod

schema:itemListElement.schema:name: Today (MOTD)
schema:itemListElement.schema:description: Live message + picture of the day. PUTs to /public/motd.jsonld; every open window cross-fades to changes via solid-0.1 WebSocket notifications.
schema:itemListElement.schema:author: hub-pod

schema:itemListElement.schema:name: Note
schema:itemListElement.schema:description: Edit schema:TextDocument / Article / CreativeWork notes — title + markdown body, autosave, delete. Renders in hub and the desktops.
schema:itemListElement.schema:author: solid-apps

schema:itemListElement.schema:name: Event
schema:itemListElement.schema:description: Render an iCal Vevent / schema:Event — details, time, location.
schema:itemListElement.schema:author: solid-apps

schema:itemListElement.schema:name: List
schema:itemListElement.schema:description: Render a schema:ItemList as a checkable todo list — add/complete/edit items.
schema:itemListElement.schema:author: solid-apps

schema:itemListElement.schema:name: Bookmark
schema:itemListElement.schema:description: Render a bookmark:Bookmark — title, link, tags.
schema:itemListElement.schema:author: solid-apps

schema:itemListElement.schema:name: Post
schema:itemListElement.schema:description: Render an ActivityStreams Note (social post) — author, content, date.
schema:itemListElement.schema:author: solid-apps

schema:itemListElement.schema:name: Reef
schema:itemListElement.schema:description: A Knots-style Bitcoin node in a tab: the BLAKE2b testnet4 synced from a verified UTXO snapshot and every block validated in the page, with the familiar Overview, Send, Receive, Transactions and Node window (console included).
schema:itemListElement.schema:author: melvincarvalho

schema:itemListElement.schema:name: Bight
schema:itemListElement.schema:description: A mempool monitor in a tab, in the mempool.space shape: every transaction validated by the tab’s own node, and the next block is the one this tab would build. BLAKE2b testnet4.
schema:itemListElement.schema:author: melvincarvalho

schema:itemListElement.schema:name: Winch
schema:itemListElement.schema:description: Solo mining in a tab: the block built and checked by the tab’s own node from its own mempool, hashed in the tab in testnet’s twenty-minute window, and handed to the chain.
schema:itemListElement.schema:author: melvincarvalho

schema:itemListElement.schema:name: Hitch
schema:itemListElement.schema:description: Payment channels in a tab, Lightning-shaped: a 2-of-2 funding output, revocable commitments, penalties; funded, watched and settled by the tab’s own node.
schema:itemListElement.schema:author: melvincarvalho
